description: This Java source file defines the AndroidSdkData class, which manages Android SDK information, targets, and DDMLib initialization for Android development within JetBrains IDEs. It includes methods for SDK target retrieval, SDK path handling, and ADB (Android Debug Bridge) management.

classes.name: AndroidSdkData
classes.description: Manages Android SDK data, including targets, SDK paths, and DDMLib initialization for Android development in JetBrains IDEs.

classes.name: MyInitializeDdmlibTask
classes.description: A modal task for waiting until ADB (Android Debug Bridge) initialization completes.

methods.name: getSdkData
methods.description: Static method to retrieve AndroidSdkData instance based on SDK location or project context.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the SDK installation directory as a File object.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Deprecated method returning the SDK path as a String.

methods.name: getLatestBuildTool
methods.description: Returns the latest build tool information.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of Android SDK targets.

methods.name: findTargetByName
methods.description: Finds an Android target by its name.

methods.name: findTargetByApiLevel
methods.description: Finds an Android target by its API level.

methods.name: findTargetByHashString
methods.description: Finds an Android target by its hash string.

methods.name: getPlatformToolsRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of platform tools.

methods.name: getSdkToolsRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of SDK tools.

methods.name: getDebugBridge
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Android Debug Bridge for device communication.

methods.name: terminateDdmlib
methods.description: Terminates the DDMLib and disconnects the debug bridge.
